verdicts.reason: A leaves 'here' as an orphan on the last headline line, scatters the flavour pills raggedly in the wrong order (Blood Orange is alone on a second row) and squeezes the legal text into a tiny column next to the pills, which crowds the right side. B breaks the headline better ('are here'), puts the pills on a grid matching the CTA's width, and runs the legal line underneath. B is still not ready to ship: the pill order is changed from the original, the CTA button is oversized and heavy compared with the original, and the right column sits tight to the edge.
